cards.basicText:
Instead of using Soulfire, you may discard this card to add +2 to the value of your played ⭐ card.
You may only play one copy of BOB'S ADVICE per combat.
cards.title: Bob's Advice

cards.basicText: Draw 1 card. Place Dresden in any space. If any friendly fighters were adjacent to Dresden, you may place those fighters on spaces adjacent to Dresden's new space. Gain 1 action.
cards.title: Aparturum

cards.basicText:
Draw 1 card. Gain 1 action.
ONGOING: When you draw a card, you may place it here. When 2 cards are placed here, you may discard this card to deal damage to an adjacent fighter equal to half the total BOOST value of those 2 cards (rounded down). Move that fighter up to 4 spaces.
cards.title: Kinetic Rings

cards.afterText: If you won the combat, deal an amount of damage to the opposing fighter equal to their played card's BOOST value.
cards.title: Shield Bracelet ⭐

cards.immediateText: Cancel all effects on your opponent's card.
cards.title: Spellbreaker

cards.afterText: If you won the combat, draw 2 cards.
cards.immediateText: The opposing fighter cannot leave their space for the rest of the turn.
cards.title: Arctis ⭐

cards.afterText: Move the opposing fighter up to 3 spaces.
cards.title: Forzare ⭐

cards.afterText: Draw 1 card. Then, if you lost the combat, look at your opponent's hand and choose a card for them to discard.
cards.title: Confront any Demon or God

cards.afterText:
Choose one option:
► Dresden recovers 1 health.
► Move each of your fighters up to 2 spaces.
cards.title: Hell's Bells!

cards.afterText: If you won the combat, choose a ⭐ card in your discard pile and add it to your hand.
cards.title: Knowledge of the Art

cards.duringText: You may choose to make the value of the opposing player's card equal to their card's BOOST value. If you do, it cannot be changed.
cards.title: Ventas Fulmino ⭐

cards.afterText: Move a fighter in this combat up to 2 spaces. If you won the combat, instead, move each fighter in your zone up to 2 spaces. If you dealt 2 or more damage, also move each fighter in adjacent zones up to 2 spaces.
cards.title: Ventris Cyclis ⭐

cards.basicText:
This attack is ► PYRO FUEGO! if Dresden has less health than the opposing fighter.
PYRO FUEGO! ⭐ (attack 5) — AFTER COMBAT: Move the opposing fighter up to 2 spaces.
cards.title: Fuego! ⭐

cards.afterText: Your opponent discards a card from their hand matching the type of card they played (attack, defense, or versatile). If they cannot, they reveal their hand to you instead.
cards.title: Banishing Roar

cards.afterText: You may search your discard pile for a non-versatile attack card and add it to your hand.
cards.title: Tiny But Fierce

cards.afterText:
► COVER FIRE
COVER FIRE (attack 2) — AFTER COMBAT: Move Dresden up to 3 spaces.
cards.title: FN P-90

hero.name: Harry Dresden
hero.specialAbility:
SOULFIRE
When Dresden plays a card with a ⭐ symbol, DURING COMBAT: You may add +1 or +2 to that card's value by dealing Dresden an equal amount of damage.
Choose Mouse or Karrin Murphy as your sidekick at the start of the game. Shuffle their cards into your deck.

name: Harry Dresden
note: Rules-enforced Pro deck (server hero harry-dresden), mirrored from the-unmatched.club deck 2865 "Harry Dresden (The Dresden Files)" (the page is this deck's sourceUrl). Card titles, types, values, boosts, quantities and banners are read off the author's card IMAGES re-uploaded 2026-11-11 (the club's structured JSON is stale) and match the engine's data/heroes/harry-dresden.rules.ts (engine #1092 on feature/dresden). Six titles carry " ⭐" (U+2B50) for the pentacle printed beside them — the engine's own spelling, and art matches on the title. The id `harry-dresden` is unbrewed-minted (William Afton precedent). SIDEKICK CHOICE (engine #1091, protocol v42): Dresden picks Mouse (7 HP, melee) or Karrin Murphy (5 HP, ranged) at setup. `sidekick` is Mouse, the first option; `sidekickOptions` lists both, and each card tagged `sidekickOption` is in the game only with that sidekick. 18 printed titles, 34 printed copies: 26 shared + 4 per sidekick, so either game deck is 30. Service Pistol is ONE printed card in both sets (the engine writes it as two card ids, HERO-only with Mouse, ANY with Murphy). This snapshot cannot be dealt by hand (it would deal all 34), so it is kept out of the sandbox, /table and every hand-dealt surface (lib/evergreenDecks.ts PRO_ONLY_DECK_IDS). ART: the 18 faces are the club's full-card renders drawn FULL-BLEED via cardImage, the cardback is the club cover, the Mouse and Karrin Murphy tokens are crops of the club's character images, and the Harry Dresden token is a crop of the Ventris Cyclis card art. The art is uncredited third-party artwork whose licence is unresolved (R7), so the deck stays LAB ONLY; never route it to the art-generation pipeline. Engine serves the hero at tier `lab`.
